_comment: Copy to <workspace>/cockpit.json. colors: Konsole tab colour per folder path relative to the workspace (longest match wins; the root is listed under its name). name: the root's session, tab and dashboard row name (default: the workspace folder's name). vault: 1Password vault that `secret` keeps a copy of every secret in (optional).. hidden: folders the dashboard and job runner skip. aliases: renamed folders (old name -> new name). old_roots: earlier workspace locations, so their transcripts still count. job_host: hostname that runs the jobs when several machines share the workspace (jobs marked `# machines: all` run everywhere; unset: all jobs everywhere). job_takeover: false stops the other machines from taking over when the job host's heartbeat is a day old (default true).
